identification: layout (mod 12) + assumption that the finest visible groups are the slide's finest
notes: Group number assumed (finest visible pair taken as the slide's finest). Pass --pixel-size (approx. is fine) or --coarsest-group to confirm; the alternative is 2 groups coarser.
Bars reach the camera's full scale (255) in 18 element(s) (G4E1-G6E6): clipped peaks bias contrast; lower the exposure if possible.

The limit element has only 1.28 px per line: its contrast relies on sub-pixel averaging along the (tilted) bars. A single row of pixels reads -0.1% there. The result is close to the camera's sampling limit.
